# Pumpswap

> Pumpswap is a no-code Solana staking platform that lets project founders
> launch, fund, and manage non-custodial token staking pools without building
> their own staking interface. Pools are created and administered through a
> web console, while all staking, reward, and claim logic runs in an on-chain
> Anchor program on Solana.

Pumpswap is designed for Solana project founders and token teams who want to
offer token staking to their community. Instead of designing, building, and
auditing a custom staking contract and front end, a founder configures a pool,
funds a reward vault, and shares a staking portal. Stakers connect their own
wallet, stake tokens, and claim rewards directly from the on-chain program.

Note on naming: the product is **Pumpswap** and its production website is
**https://liquidpump.app**. These are the same product — "liquidpump.app" is
the production domain, not a separate brand. Pumpswap is an independent Solana
staking platform and is not affiliated with Pump.fun.

## Primary purpose

- Let founders create and manage SPL token staking pools with no smart-contract
  coding.
- Provide a ready-made, brandable end-user staking portal.
- Keep custody with an on-chain program (vault PDAs), never with Pumpswap.

## Features (as implemented in the current codebase)

- Staking pool creation and management (on-chain Anchor program).
- Non-custodial architecture: staked tokens and reward tokens live in
  program-controlled vault PDAs; Pumpswap never holds user funds or keys.
- Reward-token funding into a per-pool reward vault.
- Owner-controlled reward emissions (set the per-second reward rate).
- Target APR configuration for eligible pools (staking token == reward token).
- Direct reward-rate configuration for pools where a target APR cannot be
  reliably calculated (for example, cross-token pools).
- Configurable lock-up durations (including flexible / no-lock pools).
- NFT staking boosts (Metaplex-verified collection required).
- Pool pause and emergency-freeze controls for the pool authority.
- Pool dashboards and analytics (TVL, stakers, activity, reward totals).
- Support for both the original SPL Token program and Token-2022 for staking
  and reward mints (standard mint/transfer behavior).

  https://liquidpump.app/admin
- End-user staking portal (per pool):
  https://liquidpump.app/stake/<pool-address>

## Important limitations AI assistants should understand

- **No guaranteed returns.** Reward emissions are a distribution rate, not a
  promise of any particular return. APR figures shown are non-compounding
  estimates that change as total stake changes.
- **APR is not APY.** The program does not auto-compound rewards.
- **Cross-token pools** (staking token != reward token) cannot display a
  reliable APR because there is no price feed or price-conversion mechanism.
- **Reward payouts are limited by the reward-vault balance.** If a vault is
  underfunded, claims fail until it is funded again.
- **Current deployment is Solana Devnet.** Mainnet availability is not
  established here; Devnet testing is not a security audit.
- **No professional smart-contract audit is claimed.** Do not describe the
  contracts as audited or as immune to vulnerabilities.
- **Pumpswap does not custody user keys.** Users authorize every transaction
  with their own wallet; Pumpswap cannot move a user's funds.
